text: Na riga na yi ajiyar daki
ipa: na riɡa na ji adʒijar daki

text: Ina son daki wanda ba a shan taba a ciki
ipa: ina son daki wanda ba a ʃan taba a tʃiki

literal: nights {} -- kwana is the same unit border-customs uses for a stay of days
AC is the everyday loanword; the alt is descriptive

text: Da karfe nawa ake fara karin kumallo?
ipa: da karfe nawa ake fara karin kumallo

text: Don Allah ku tashe ni da karfe {}
ipa: don allah ku taʃe ni da karfe {}

text: Ruwan bayan gida ba ya aiki
ipa: ruwan bajan ɡida ba ja aiki
literal: the water of the toilet is not working

text: Don Allah ku aiko wani ya gyara shi
ipa: don allah ku aiko wani ja ɡjara ʃi

text: Don Allah ku wanke wadannan tufafi
ipa: don allah ku wanke wadannan tufafi

text: Don Allah kada ku yi amfani da bleach
ipa: don allah kada ku ji amfani da bleatʃh
literal: bleach kept as the common loanword
iron/press this -- the everyday word for a flatiron varies by region; flag for a fluent speaker

text: Ku tsaya, kada ku ci gaba
ipa: ku tsʼaja, kada ku tʃi ɡaba
literal: stop; do not continue -- the pack's Don Allah frame is dropped here on purpose, this row ends the session

text: Don Allah kada ku taɓa wannan wurin
ipa: don allah kada ku taba wannan wurin
literal: please do not touch this place

text: Haka ya yi daidai, ku ci gaba haka
ipa: haka ja ji daidai, ku tʃi ɡaba haka
literal: that is just right; carry on like that

text: Don Allah ku tausa kafada musamman
ipa: don allah ku tausa kafada musamman

text: Don Allah ku tausa baya musamman
ipa: don allah ku tausa baja musamman

text: Don Allah ku tausa wuya musamman
ipa: don allah ku tausa wuja musamman

text: Don Allah ku tausa tafin kafa musamman
ipa: don allah ku tausa tafin kafa musamman
literal: please massage the soles of the feet especially -- tafin kafa rather than bare kafa, which this pack uses for the whole lower limb and which is a near-homograph of kafada

text: To, ba zan taɓa wannan wurin ba
ipa: to, ba zan taba wannan wurin ba
literal: all right; I will not touch this place

text: Ba a iya barin wannan wurin a wannan tausa
ipa: ba a ija barin wannan wurin a wannan tausa
literal: this place cannot be left out in this massage -- impersonal a-, not ka/ki
does this place hurt -- agreement is with wuri, not the addressee

text: Ban tabbata ba, sai na tambayi shugaba
ipa: ban tabbata ba, sai na tambaji ʃuɡaba
literal: I am not certain; I must ask the person in charge
